premises.text: Synthetic post-harvest pesticides are harmful and being banned, while natural wax alternatives are hard to scale
premises.evidence_span: currently used pesticides are synthetic compounds, which are harmful to human beings and the environment, so they are being banned

premises.text: Non-GMO microbial fermentation produces transparent, odorless, tasteless biomolecule coatings
premises.evidence_span: Our coatings are based on biomolecules produced by non-GMOs, which were isolated from nature. These coatings are transparent, odorless, and tasteless

premises.text: The coating regulates gas exchange to delay ripening and delivers antimicrobials in a structural matrix at low dose
premises.evidence_span: forming a coating that regulates the gas exchange between the fruit and the environment, delaying the ripening process

premises.text: Formulation matches common synthetic fungicide efficacy so produce can be marketed with zero chemical residues
premises.evidence_span: our formulation showed to be as effective as the most commonly used synthetic fungicide in citrus. And this means that our customers will be able to market their produce as zero chemical residues

premises.text: Coating extends shelf life and reduces weight loss and firmness loss in long produce value chains
premises.evidence_span: our coating also extend the shelf life of produce, like our climacteric fruits, like avocados, gaining up to five days of shelf life

premises.text: Product integrates with existing packing machinery without special equipment
premises.evidence_span: The product integrates seamlessly with existing machinery, so there is no need to invest in special equipment

premises.text: Cell-free formulations are stable and easy to store unlike living-microbe competitors
premises.evidence_span: Our cell-free formulations are stable and can be easily stored

value.text: Protect produce and fight food waste without compromising human or planetary health
value.evidence_span: help fight against food waste and food insecurity without compromising human or planetary health

secondary_value.text: Customers capture a zero-residue price premium without losing decay control
secondary_value.evidence_span: market their produce as zero chemical residues, capturing a price premium and without compromising decay control

causal_links.evidence_span: The coating also provides a structural matrix, preventing the drift and enhancing the delivery of the antimicrobials
harmful to human beings and the environment
